name: @gjsify/machine-fit
description: Will a model run on this machine, and on which backend? A static memory check (RAM, VRAM, unified memory) that can rule a model out before download, plus the probe that decides speed: backends tried against a wall-clock budget, a GPU-hang guard, Vulkan and battery hints. Pure TypeScript on node:* APIs.

scripts.clear: gjsify clear lib tmp tsconfig.tsbuildinfo test.gjs.mjs test.node.mjs
scripts.build: gjsify run build:gjsify && gjsify run build:types
scripts.build:test: gjsify run build:test:gjs && gjsify run build:test:node
scripts.test: gjsify run build:gjsify && gjsify run build:test && gjsify run test:node && gjsify run test:gjs

osNotes.darwin: Apple silicon's GPU share of unified memory is approximated (75 % of RAM unless iogpu.wired_limit_mb is set); Metal's recommendedMaxWorkingSetSize needs native code. Intel Macs report their GPU as unknown. hasVulkan() is always false.
osNotes.win32: Only NVIDIA VRAM is read (nvidia-smi ships with the driver); other GPUs report unknown memory, because DXGI needs native code and WMI's AdapterRAM stops at 4 GiB. onBattery() is always false and hasVulkan() is always false.
